info.title: Arcanist REST API
info.description: REST equivalent of the Arcanist GraphQL API (/graphql), without subscriptions. Authenticate with POST /rest/v1/auth/login and send the access token as a Bearer token.

post.summary: Creates a folder on the server, to pick it as a library location.

get.summary: Checks the ffmpeg at the given path, or which one would be found automatically.

post.summary: Reads an mStream installation, from its folder on this server or from its server, to choose what to import.

get.summary: Looks for DLNA/UPnP media servers on the local networks, to copy music from once set up.
The media server at a description URL.
A folder of a media server; 0 is the root.

post.summary: The backups in a folder of this server or an S3 bucket that carry a server, to restore it instead of setting it up.
Whether the password opens a snapshot's server data.
Restores the server from a snapshot (its database, settings and keys) and restarts to install it; afterwards, if asked, the libraries' missing files come back too.

get.summary: Public description of the server. Does not require authentication.

delete.summary: Removes a location and its tracks from the catalog; files on disk are not touched. A local library's only folder cannot be removed (last_source): move it instead. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

post.summary: Moves a local library's folder to another folder of the server in the background: copies every file, points the library at the new folder and, unless keepOriginals, deletes the old files. Nothing is overwritten. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

get.summary: Library folder moves since the server started, the latest first, with their progress. Administrators only.
Folders on the server, for choosing library locations. Lists the file system roots when path is omitted. Administrators only.

post.summary: Creates a folder on the server, to pick it as a location. Administrators only.
Queues a scan, or returns the one already queued or running for the library. A full scan re-reads every file. Requires RUN_SCANS.
Moves the files of a finished organizing run back where they were, in the background. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES and a recent authentication.

put.summary: Rates a track 1–5 for the user, or clears the rating with null. With the single-star rating mode only 5 is accepted.
Makes a track one of the user's StarTracks (rates it 5), or not (clears a 5). Works with both rating modes.

get.summary: The user's StarTracks (the star in single-star mode, five stars otherwise), most recently starred first, with each song's AcoustID.

post.summary: Adds songs to the user's StarTracks, by track or by AcoustID (as Ultimate Cloud names them), at most 1000. By AcoustID, one of the song's tracks, unless one already is.
Takes songs from the user's StarTracks, by track or by AcoustID (every track of the song), at most 1000.

get.summary: The user's tracks rated at least minRating (5 for StarTracks), most recently rated first. With the single-star rating mode, only StarTracks.

post.summary: Reports that the user listened to a track. The server decides whether it counts as a play (30 seconds, and half the track or four minutes) or a skip.
Brings ratings and play counts an app kept on its own (at most 1000 of each per call). Ratings only fill gaps; play counts keep the highest.

get.summary: The user's counted plays, newest first.
Listening over a `period` (WEEK, MONTH, YEAR, ALL): the user's own, or another user's with VIEW_ALL_STATS. timeZone is an IANA id (UTC by default) for days and months.
What the libraries hold and how the server is listened to over a `period` (WEEK, MONTH, YEAR, ALL), per user. Requires VIEW_ALL_STATS.

put.summary: Chooses how users rate tracks: STARS (one to five) or STAR (a single star, kept as five). Nothing is lost when switching. Requires MANAGE_SETTINGS.

get.summary: The server's other active users, to invite as playlist collaborators.
Artists, albums, tracks and playlists matching every word of the query (as word starts, ignoring accents and case), best first. first is per kind: 10 by default, at most 50.
The user's home page: recently played and added albums, mixes, most played, starred tracks, albums to rediscover or never played, and playlists. Empty sections are left out.
Mixes made for the user from their favorite artists, genres and decades, their favorites and music they never played. They change once a day.
A mix's tracks in play order. Besides the ids from mixes, any artist:<id>, genre:<id>, decade:<year> or track:<id> (a radio started from a track) works, ids without dashes.
Everything an artist page shows: top tracks, albums, albums the artist appears on, related artists and the artist's mix.
Whether the server is in maintenance (migrating its database) and how far it got. Anyone can ask, also during maintenance.

put.summary: Uploads, downloads or both between a library and the Ultimate Cloud account (Cloud plan); nothing is deleted on either side. Administrators only; turning it on needs a recent authentication.

post.summary: Syncs a library with Ultimate Cloud now (otherwise every 6 hours). Administrators only.

get.summary: No telemetry, and which outside services the server may use. Requires MANAGE_SETTINGS.

put.summary: Chooses no telemetry (anonymous statistics off; linked accounts start without sending plays) and which outside services may be used: ALL, ULTIMATE_CLOUD_ONLY (no online services) or NONE (Ultimate Cloud's extension off too). What they leave out is turned off. The music server's own services are not affected. Requires MANAGE_SETTINGS.

get.summary: Whether anonymous play counts go to Ultimate Cloud's global statistics. Requires MANAGE_SETTINGS.

put.summary: Sends anonymous play counts to Ultimate Cloud's global statistics, or stops. Requires MANAGE_SETTINGS.

get.summary: Audio of a track. Authenticate with a Bearer token or the `st` parameter of a track's streamUrl. `fileId` picks a specific copy; `download=true` sends the original as an attachment and requires DOWNLOAD. Without `format`, `maxBitRate` or `timeOffset` the original is sent with HTTP range support. `format` (see serverInfo.transcodingFormats) converts it, at `maxBitRate` kbit/s if given; `maxBitRate` alone converts to MP3 only when the original exceeds it. Converted audio has no range support: seek by requesting again with `timeOffset` in seconds. 503 transcoding_unavailable without ffmpeg.

head.summary: Audio of a track. Authenticate with a Bearer token or the `st` parameter of a track's streamUrl. `fileId` picks a specific copy; `download=true` sends the original as an attachment and requires DOWNLOAD. Without `format`, `maxBitRate` or `timeOffset` the original is sent with HTTP range support. `format` (see serverInfo.transcodingFormats) converts it, at `maxBitRate` kbit/s if given; `maxBitRate` alone converts to MP3 only when the original exceeds it. Converted audio has no range support: seek by requesting again with `timeOffset` in seconds. 503 transcoding_unavailable without ffmpeg.

get.summary: An album or track image by artworkId. `size` scales it so its longest side fits (64, 128, 256, 512 or 1024). Public and cacheable forever, so it can be used directly in image elements.
The signed-in user.
Devices where the signed-in user is currently signed in.

delete.summary: Signs out one of the signed-in user's devices.

post.summary: Changes the signed-in user's password and signs out their other devices.

get.summary: All users. Requires the MANAGE_USERS permission.

post.summary: Requires MANAGE_USERS and a recent authentication.

get.summary: A user by id. Requires the MANAGE_USERS permission.

put.summary: Requires MANAGE_USERS and a recent authentication.

delete.summary: Requires MANAGE_USERS and a recent authentication.

put.summary: Replaces the libraries explicitly granted to a user. Requires MANAGE_USERS and a recent authentication.

post.summary: Sets a new password and signs the user out everywhere. Requires MANAGE_USERS and a recent authentication.

get.summary: Libraries the signed-in user can access.

post.summary: Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

get.summary: A library by id. Libraries the user cannot access are reported as not found.

put.summary: Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

delete.summary: Removes the library and its tracks from the catalog; files on disk are not touched. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES and a recent authentication.

post.summary: Adds an audio file (the request body, `application/octet-stream`; its name in `fileName`) to a library the user can access, placed with the library's template and never overwriting. 201 when it entered the library (catalogued by a scan shortly after the last upload), 200 when the library already had that audio. Requires UPLOAD.
Checks that an S3 bucket answers with those keys, and how much music it holds. Needs the Cloud plan. Administrators only.
A library in an S3 bucket (any S3-compatible service). Needs the Cloud plan. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.
Adds a location to a library. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

get.summary: Most recent scans first, of one library or of all libraries the user can see. Requires RUN_SCANS or MANAGE_LIBRARIES.
A scan by id, including live progress while it runs. Poll it to follow a scan. Requires RUN_SCANS or MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

post.summary: Requires RUN_SCANS.

get.summary: Progress of the background audio analysis (loudness, fingerprints, waveforms, tempo and key). Poll it to follow progress. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

put.summary: Turns the background audio analysis on or off. Requires MANAGE_SETTINGS.

get.summary: Where Arcanist found ffmpeg, and the progress of a download. Requires MANAGE_SETTINGS.

put.summary: Uses the ffmpeg at the given path, or finds one automatically when null. Fails with not_ffmpeg if it does not work. Administrators only, with a recent password.

post.summary: Downloads ffmpeg (a static GPL build from BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds) into the data directory in the background. Poll the status to follow it. Administrators only, with a recent password.

get.summary: Pairs of tracks whose audio is similar but not enough to merge them automatically, most similar first. `status` is OPEN (default) or DISMISSED. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

post.summary: Merges an open pair into keepTrackId, one of its two tracks, and returns it. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.
Keeps the two tracks of an open pair apart; it is not proposed again. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

put.summary: Sets the library's path template and whether files added to it are organized automatically. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

get.summary: What organizing the library would move, with the given template or the library's own. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

post.summary: Moves the library's files to the paths its template gives them, in the background. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES and a recent authentication.

get.summary: The library's latest organizing runs, newest first. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.
Folders whose files are imported into libraries. Administrators only.

post.summary: Administrators only.

put.summary: Administrators only.

delete.summary: Stops importing from the folder and forgets its history; its files are not touched. Administrators only.

get.summary: Files found in drop folders, most recently changed first: in the given `status`, or else those still in a drop folder. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.
How many files of the drop folders are in each state. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

post.summary: Imports a file even though it is incomplete or a duplicate (then as another copy of its track), first writing the given tags into it. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.
Looks at a file again, as if it had just been dropped. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.
Leaves a file in its drop folder; it is looked at again only if it changes. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.
Moves a file to its drop folder's trash, from which it is deleted after a while. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

get.summary: The user's playlists, those they collaborate on and public ones, most recently changed first.
A playlist by id. Playlists the user cannot see are reported as not found.

put.summary: Renames, describes and shares a playlist. Owner only.

get.summary: A playlist's tracks in order, page by page (100 by default, at most 1000).

post.summary: Adds tracks at the end or at a position. Owner and collaborators.
Makes a private playlist of the user's own with the tracks of one they can see.
Removes entries. Owner and collaborators.
Moves entries together to a position, keeping their order. Owner and collaborators.

put.summary: Replaces the users who can add, remove and reorder the playlist's tracks. Owner only.

get.summary: Installed web players; the default one is served at /. Administrators only.

post.summary: Installs (or updates) the web player in an uploaded .zip with arcanist-frontend.json at its root (form field `file`). Administrators only, with a recent authentication.
Downloads a web player's .zip and installs it (or updates it). It runs with the user's session: install only what you trust. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

put.summary: Serves this web player at /. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

delete.summary: Removes an installed web player. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

get.summary: Built-in and installed extensions, with what happened to them at startup. Administrators only.

post.summary: Installs (or updates) the extension in an uploaded .zip with arcanist-extension.json at its root (form field `file`); it runs once enabled and the server restarts. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

Downloads an extension's .zip and installs it (or updates it); it runs once enabled and the server restarts. Extensions run inside the server with full trust. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

put.summary: Switches an extension on or off. Built-in extensions and switching off apply at once; an installed one runs after a restart. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

delete.summary: Removes an installed extension (it stops at once and is gone after a restart). Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

get.summary: The user's app passwords, for Subsonic and mStream apps; their secrets are never shown again.

post.summary: Creates a password for one app (Subsonic, mStream) and returns its secret, only this once. Needs a recent authentication.

delete.summary: Revokes one of the user's app passwords.

get.summary: The latest imports from mStream, newest first. Administrators only.

post.summary: Imports from mStream: the chosen libraries, its users (who keep their passwords) and their playlists, ratings and play counts, which arrive once the new libraries are scanned (or, from a server, when each user first signs in). Needs a recent authentication.
Reads an mStream installation on this server (its folder or configuration file) without changing it: its libraries, users and their data. Administrators only.
Reads the libraries and users of an mStream server through its API, signing in with one of its administrators. Administrators only.

delete.summary: Removes a finished import from mStream from the history; what it brought stays. An import from an mStream server stays while some of its users have not signed in. Administrators only.

post.summary: Clears the history of migrations from mStream and DLNA servers (only finished ones, and not the mStream imports still needed to sign in); returns how many went. Administrators only.

get.summary: The DLNA media server: whether it is on, what it publishes and the addresses devices find. Administrators only.

put.summary: Sets the name devices show, the libraries published on the local network (to anyone there, without signing in) and the folders of the tree. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

get.summary: Devices on the local network Arcanist can play to (DLNA renderers); empty while DLNA is off.

post.summary: Adds a renderer by the URL of its UPnP description, for networks where it is not found by itself. Administrators only.

get.summary: What a renderer is doing: its state, position, volume and Arcanist's queue on it.

post.summary: Plays tracks on a renderer, in the best format it plays (lossless first). The plays count for the caller.
Plays, pauses, stops, skips or seeks on a renderer.

put.summary: Sets a renderer's volume, 0–100.

get.summary: How the mStream extension behaves with the mStream apps: the star threshold, signing in with the user's password and the apps' own functions. Administrators only.

put.summary: Changes how the mStream extension behaves with the mStream apps. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

post.summary: A new pairing code for the mStream apps' quick connect: apps that scanned the old one are disconnected. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

get.summary: The P2P network: whether it runs, this server's node id, its relay and what goes through it now. Administrators only.

put.summary: Turns the P2P network on or off and sets its relay, the name peers see and the global limits. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

get.summary: Nodes allowed through the P2P network, with their rules and traffic: the caller's devices, or every peer for administrators.

post.summary: An invitation to pair a device with the caller (or, for administrators, another user), valid 30 minutes. The app reads it (as a QR code) and pairs through the P2P network.
An invitation for another Arcanist server to receive libraries, with rules and an optional end, valid 7 days. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

put.summary: Changes a peer's name, rules, end and (for a server) shared libraries. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

post.summary: Ends a peer's access at once. Users revoke their own devices; administrators, any peer.

get.summary: Libraries other servers share with this one, each shown here as a library. Administrators only.

post.summary: Accepts another server's share with its invitation link: its libraries become one library here, scanned at once (nothing is downloaded: the music streams from that server). Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

Copies a received share's files into a folder of one of this server's libraries, when its owner allows downloads. Runs in the background; its progress shows in the share. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

get.summary: What happened in the P2P network, newest first: pairings, connections, streams, refusals and revocations. Administrators only.

post.summary: Pairs the calling device with the user of a device invitation. Only through the P2P network.
Accepts a share invitation for the calling server. Only through the P2P network, server to server.

get.summary: Server to server: this server's name, the share's rules and libraries.
Server to server: the shared files, described (tags, content hash, artwork), 500 at a time.
Server to server: a shared file's audio, under the share's rules (conversion, bit-rate cap, downloads).

head.summary: Server to server: a shared file's audio, under the share's rules (conversion, bit-rate cap, downloads).

get.summary: Server to server: the original image of a shared track's artwork.
The server's database, the last migration and the SQLite file it left. Administrators only.

post.summary: Checks that PostgreSQL answers with a connection string. Administrators only.
Copies everything to an empty PostgreSQL database with the server in maintenance, then switches to it. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.
Keeps, moves or deletes the SQLite file a migration left. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

get.summary: The linked Ultimate Cloud account, its plan and what it enables. Administrators only.

post.summary: Asks Ultimate Cloud for a code to approve on its site; the server waits for the approval. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.
Stops waiting for a code's approval. Administrators only.
Forgets the account; only the Ultimate Cloud features turn off. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.
Shows a collection of the account (its library or Cloud Drop) as a library of this server; nothing is downloaded. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.
Reads the account's plan again now. Administrators only.

put.summary: Chooses which of Ultimate Cloud's online services this server takes part in: plays for the statistics and rankings, albums heard whole, StarTracks, the account's statistics. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

get.summary: The Ultimate Cloud accounts linked to this server, for choosing where uploads go. Administrators only.
The linked account's listening statistics as Ultimate Cloud counts them. Administrators only.
How each library with folders on this server syncs with the Ultimate Cloud account. Administrators only.
The caller's own Ultimate Cloud account and what it brings them: their music as a personal library, their plays, statistics, StarTracks and devices.

post.summary: Asks Ultimate Cloud for a code to approve on its site, to link the caller's own account; the server waits for the approval. Needs a recent authentication.
Stops waiting for the approval of the caller's code.
Forgets the caller's own account and removes their personal library; nothing is touched in Ultimate Cloud. Needs a recent authentication.
Reads the plan of the caller's own account again now.

put.summary: Chooses what the caller's own account gets from this server: their plays, albums heard whole, StarTracks, statistics.

get.summary: The caller's own account's listening statistics as Ultimate Cloud counts them.
What the setup wizard chose, as it is now, to run it again. Administrators only.

put.summary: The setup wizard's answers again: language, ratings, online services, anonymous statistics and ffmpeg. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

post.summary: Every server setting back to how a new server starts; libraries, users and their data stay. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.
Deletes every user's ratings, plays and playlists; users, libraries and settings stay. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

Everything back to a freshly installed server (database, settings, keys, cache; optionally players, extensions and tools); the server restarts into the setup wizard. Music folders are never touched. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

get.summary: Searches the local networks for DLNA/UPnP media servers for a few seconds. Administrators only.
The media server at a description URL, for servers the search does not find. Administrators only.
A folder of a media server (0 or none is the root): its subfolders and how much music it holds. Administrators only.
The latest copies from media servers and how far they got. Administrators only.

post.summary: Copies the music of folders of a media server into a library folder, in the background. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.
Stops a copy from a media server; what was copied stays. Administrators only.

delete.summary: Removes a finished copy from a media server from the history; what it copied stays. Administrators only.

post.summary: Walks the media server again and copies what is missing. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

get.summary: Where backups go: folders of this server, S3 buckets and other Arcanist servers. Administrators only.

post.summary: Adds a destination for backups (it must be writable). Administrators only, with a recent authentication.
Whether a destination can be written now. Administrators only.

delete.summary: Removes a destination and its backups from this server; what is in the destination stays. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

post.summary: An invitation for another Arcanist server to keep its backups in a folder of this one, valid 7 days. Needs the P2P network. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

get.summary: Other Arcanist servers that keep their backups here, with the space they take. Administrators only.
The backups of the server, its libraries, albums or playlists, with their latest run. Administrators only.

post.summary: Creates a backup. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

get.summary: A backup, with its latest run. Administrators only.

put.summary: Changes a backup (not its destination nor its kind of scope). Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

delete.summary: Removes a backup from this server; its copies in the destination stay. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

post.summary: Runs a backup now, in the background. Administrators only.

get.summary: The 20 latest runs of a backup. Administrators only.
The backups in a destination (this server's or another's), with the snapshots that can be restored. Administrators only.
What a snapshot holds (libraries, albums, playlists and users), to choose what to restore. Administrators only.
The latest restores and how far they got. Administrators only.

post.summary: Restores files and user data from a snapshot, in the background, without overwriting anything. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

get.summary: A restore and how far it got. Administrators only.

post.summary: Stops a restore; what it restored stays. Administrators only.

get.summary: A run of a backup and how far it got. Administrators only.

post.summary: Stops a run; what it copied stays, and the next run finishes its snapshot. Administrators only.

get.summary: Which online services are on (MusicBrainz, AcoustID, Cover Art Archive, LRCLib) and what each has done. Requires MANAGE_SETTINGS.

put.summary: Turns online services on or off. They send only fingerprints, identifiers and artist, album and track names. Requires MANAGE_SETTINGS.
Uses your own AcoustID application key instead of the project's; null or empty goes back to the project's. Requires MANAGE_SETTINGS.

get.summary: Performers and album artists with music the user can play, by name; optionally only those with music in a library. Pages of `first` items (default 50, at most 500) after the `after` cursor.
Albums with music the user can play, by title; optionally only those of an artist, or with music in a library.
Tracks the user can play, by title; optionally only those with a copy in a library. With albumId, all of the album's tracks in disc and track order, without paging.

post.summary: Finds the server's tracks for an app's own (at most 1000 per call): by audio hash, MusicBrainz recording, AcoustID, and last by title, artist and album.

get.summary: A track's lyrics, with synchronized lines when known. not_found when it has none.
Overview of a track's audio for seek bars, from its best copy or the given file. not_found until the copy is analyzed.
